name: Enhanced clean up tool
description: Improves the clean up feature in the code area's right click context menu with multiple columns and suggestions of removing unused variables and lists.

info.text: This addon was previously part of the "developer tools" addon but has moved here.

settings.name: Find unused variables
settings.description: Find unused reporters, variables and lists for this sprite only and ask to delete them.

settings.name: Gap between scripts (px)
settings.description: Vertical gap between scripts in each column after clean up. Set to 0 to use the workspace grid size.

settings.name: Live tidy-up
settings.description: Automatically push scripts down to keep spacing when blocks are added to a stack above them.
